sentences.en: He was a strange little ferret-like man, with white eyelashes.
sentences.zh: 他是一个奇怪的小像臭鼬一样的男人，长着白色的睫毛。

sentences.en: Mascara darkens the eyelashes and makes them appear longer.
sentences.zh: 睫毛膏可以加深睫毛的颜色，并让它们看起来更长。

sentences.en: Did you get fake eyelashes or did you get a treatment?
sentences.zh: 你贴了假睫毛还是做了其他护理？
